data.question: My maize has small holes in the leaves
data.headline: This sounds like fall armyworm

confidence.reason: based on common advice for this question

data.whatsHappening: Small holes in young maize leaves are often the first sign of fall armyworm feeding inside the funnel.
data.whyItMatters: Maize this young can lose many leaves in a week.
steps: Walk your field in a W and look closely at 20 plants.
Crush egg clusters and small caterpillars by hand.

If 4 or more of the 20 plants have fresh damage: If you must spray, use only a product on RAB’s approved list from a registered agro-dealer. Follow the label, wear gloves and a mask, and keep children away.
data.followUp: Add a photo so Inama can be surer.
sources: FAO guidance on fall armyworm management
Rwanda Agriculture Board (RAB) crop protection guidance
